paragraphs.text: Jeff Franzmann , also known as Canticle , is a Canadian author. He wrote a column titled "Single Card Strategies" and invented Gleemax , a fictional brain-in-a-jar that supposedly controls R&D .

Single Card Strategies was initially self-published on Usenet. The column was carried in The Duelist issues #10-25, from 1996 through 1998. Around March 1996, he founded Canticle Publishing to publish a quarterly magazine, also titled Single Card Strategies. The first issue of the magazine was published in August. More than 80 of Franzmann's columns were collected into Single Card Strategies for Magic: The Gathering , a book published in 1996. Philip Kramer and Beth Moursund are credited as co-authors.

Franzmann framed his columns in short fiction, for which he invented the plane of Torwynn and included his personal character, Canticle. He also created the character Gleemax in a sarcastic response to a Usenet thread asking whether "there [is] a brain behind" R&D .
